qube.engine.mode.description: Inference backend: in-process GGUF (internal) or OpenAI-compatible localhost server (external).

qube.memory.enrichment.description: When enabled, extracts memories from chat, summarises sessions, and runs periodic memory reflection (higher RAM/LLM use). Retrieval of existing memories is unaffected when off.

qube.memory.promotion_enabled.description: When enabled, periodically promotes well-used context/knowledge memories to the preference tier (requires memory enrichment).

qube.memory.promotion_acknowledged.description: True after the user accepted the one-time confirmation when enabling memory promotion.

qube.memory.promotion_preset.description: How cautious Qube is before promoting a memory (conservative, standard, or aggressive).

qube.memory.v7_salvage_enabled.description: When enabled, enqueue salvage memory extraction when chat history is windowed (requires memory enrichment).

qube.memory.consolidation_enabled.description: When enabled, stages cross-day memory review hints in Memory Manager without auto-promoting or deleting.

qube.discourse.grounding_enabled.description: When enabled, classifies follow-up turns and tracks active conversation topic to improve pronoun resolution and reduce retrieval hijacking on CHAT turns.

qube.chat.personality_nudge_enabled.description: When enabled, general chat turns (no retrieval sources) gently encourage one optional short follow-up question or invitation when appropriate—not on RAG, memory recall, or web-grounded turns.

qube.sidecar.enabled.description: When true and the bundled Qwen3 1.7B GGUF is present under models/cognition/, background cognition (memory judge, reflection, episodes, titling) uses the CPU sidecar instead of the primary LLM.

qube.sidecar.query_rewrite_enabled.description: Assistive follow-up query expansion for retrieval (hybrid with original query; never changes user-visible text).

qube.sidecar.source_digest_enabled.description: Best-effort compression of retrieved sources before the primary model prompt (bounded timeout; falls back to raw sources).

qube.sidecar.source_digest_min_chars.description: Only run source digest when retrieved context is at least this many characters; smaller contexts pass through unchanged.

qube.sidecar.min_rewrite_confidence.description: Minimum sidecar confidence to apply query expansion for hybrid retrieval.

qube.sidecar.foreground_timeout_ms.description: Max wait for sidecar on the hot path (query rewrite, source digest) before deterministic fallback.

qube.sidecar.ingest_blurb_enabled.description: Generate one-sentence Library document blurbs at ingest time via the sidecar.

qube.sidecar.model_path.description: Absolute path to optional auxiliary cognition GGUF; empty uses bundled Qwen3 1.7B default in models/cognition/.

qube.sidecar.chat_format.description: Chat template for auxiliary cognition prompts; auto infers from model filename.

qube.settings.advanced_engine_unlocked.description: When true, shows advanced native-engine controls including optional cognition model swap.

qube.settings.advanced_engine_acknowledg.description: User acknowledged RAM impact warning for advanced engine / cognition settings.

qube.settings.advanced_embedding_unlocke.description: When true, shows advanced Knowledge settings including optional embedding model swap.

qube.embedding.modelPath.description: Absolute path to optional embedding GGUF; empty uses bundled Nomic Embed v1.5 in models/embedding/.

qube.settings.advanced_stt_unlocked.description: When true, shows advanced Voice settings for optional STT model swap.

qube.settings.advanced_tts_unlocked.description: When true, shows advanced Voice settings for optional TTS model swap.

qube.settings.advanced_hardware_unlocked.description: When true, shows advanced AI & Models hardware tuning (GPU layers and CPU threads).

qube.settings.advanced_chat_template_unl.description: When true, shows advanced AI & Models chat template override for the native engine.

qube.diagnostics.routing_debug_log_enabl.description: When true, append one JSON line per chat turn to routing_debug.log for troubleshooting.

qube.skills.enabled.description: When true, compositional reasoning skills inject non-authoritative prompt guidance after routing (does not change routes or tools).

qube.skills.min_activation_score.description: Minimum per-skill activation score (0–1) to include in the prompt.

qube.skills.max_active_skills.description: Maximum number of skills composited into one turn.

qube.skills.total_prompt_char_budget.description: Character budget for all skill guidance blocks combined.

qube.skills.embedding_boost_enabled.description: When true, optional embedding centroid similarity may boost skill scores (substring remains primary).

qube.skills.debug_log_enabled.description: When true, append per-turn skill activation JSONL to skills_debug.log.

qube.stt.modelPath.description: Absolute path to optional CTranslate2 Whisper folder under models/stt/; empty uses bundled Whisper small.

qube.tts.modelPath.description: Absolute path to optional TTS .onnx under models/tts/; empty uses bundled Kokoro v1.0.

qube.profile.units.description: Explicit measurement units preference; null uses conversation-inferred profile only.

qube.profile.locale.description: Explicit locale (e.g. en-DK); null uses inferred profile only.

qube.profile.displayName.description: Explicit display name for the user; null uses inferred profile only.

qube.profile.verbosity.description: Explicit response verbosity; null uses inferred profile only.

qube.native.modelPath.description: Path to the active internal .gguf model (shard 1 resolved automatically).

qube.native.gpuLayers.description: GPU layers for llama.cpp; null uses a hardware-based suggestion on first use.

qube.native.cpuThreads.description: Blas/ggml thread count; null uses a CPU-based default on first use.

qube.native.chatFormat.description: Chat template selection for the internal llama.cpp engine.

qube.native.promptLayout.description: Global prompt layout override for internal engine turns.

qube.native.autoLoadOnStartup.description: Auto-load the saved internal model when entering internal mode or at startup.

qube.native.reasoningDisplay.description: Show thinking tokens in native chat; null means use model telemetry defaults.

qube.llm.contextLimit.description: Model context window (n_ctx): total tokens shared by prompt and reply.

qube.llm.outputTokenLimitEnabled.description: When enabled, cap each assistant reply at outputTokenLimit tokens.

qube.llm.outputTokenLimit.description: Maximum new tokens per assistant reply when outputTokenLimitEnabled is true.

qube.llm.chatHistoryMessages.description: How many recent chat messages to include in each LLM request.

qube.llm.topK.description: Top-K sampling limit; 0 disables top-K filtering.

qube.llm.repeatPenalty.description: Repeat penalty discourages the model from reusing recent tokens.

qube.llm.presencePenalty.description: Presence penalty discourages tokens that already appeared in the output.

qube.llm.minP.description: Min-P sampling floor; 0 disables min-P filtering.

qube.mcp.ragEnabled.description: When enabled, Qube may search and cite your local Knowledge Base during chat.

qube.mcp.ragAutoActivator.description: When enabled, custom NLP trigger phrases can wake the Knowledge Base for a single turn even if the master RAG switch is off.

qube.mcp.ragStrictIsolation.description: When enabled, Qube must answer only from retrieved documents and refuses general-knowledge guesses.

qube.mcp.internetHybrid.description: When enabled, Qube may search the web and use cognitive routing to decide when live internet results are needed.

qube.models.directory.description: Directory for downloaded and native .gguf models; empty uses the app default models/llm folder.

qube.modelManager.hardwareSuggestions.description: Rank and badge Qube Verified models by detected hardware in Model Manager.

qube.onboarding.localLlmTourCompleted.description: Whether the first-run local LLM setup tour has been completed.

qube.composer.atMentionDiscovered.description: User has seen the first-run @ mention shortcut discovery toast in the chat composer.

qube.wakeword.activeId.description: Identifier of the active openWakeWord model.

qube.wakeword.thresholds.description: Per-wakeword detection threshold overrides (wakeword id to float).

qube.audio.inputDeviceIndex.description: Preferred microphone device index; null uses the system default.

qube.audio.outputDeviceIndex.description: Preferred speaker device index; null uses the system default.

qube.notifications.enabled.description: Master switch for in-app and OS notifications.

qube.notifications.dnd.description: Do Not Disturb — suppress non-critical notifications.

qube.notifications.suppressWhenFocused.description: Suppress info/success toasts while the main window is focused.

qube.notifications.soundEnabled.description: Play alert sounds for error/critical notifications.

qube.notifications.osWhenHidden.description: Show OS notifications when the window is hidden or unfocused.

qube.notifications.showPreview.description: Include message preview text in turn-complete notifications.

qube.notifications.categories.voice.description: Voice pipeline notifications (STT failures, mic errors).

qube.notifications.categories.turnComple.description: Notify when an assistant reply is ready while hidden.

qube.companion.enabled.description: Show the floating desktop companion when Qube is tray-hidden.

qube.companion.showWhenTrayHidden.description: Show companion while the main window is hidden to the system tray.

qube.companion.showWhileWindowOpen.description: Keep companion visible even when the main window is open.

qube.companion.idleFadeSec.description: Seconds of idle listening before companion auto-fades.

qube.companion.showCaption.description: Show the activity label (Listening, Thinking, Speaking, etc.) below the companion.

qube.companion.suppressOnFullscreen.description: Hide companion when a fullscreen app is detected (non-active turns).

qube.companion.tryOnWayland.description: Attempt floating overlay on Wayland (may be unreliable).

qube.companion.dockMode.description: Use edge-docked strip mode instead of floating orb (better on Wayland).

qube.companion.reducedMotion.description: Override reduced motion; null follows system preference when detectable.

qube.companion.persona.description: Companion visual persona (sphere or qube cube).

qube.companion.idleColor.description: Base idle glow color for the desktop companion (purple = Qube brand, blue = legacy).

qube.companion.position.normX.description: Normalized X (0-1) fallback when saved screen is missing.

qube.companion.position.normY.description: Normalized Y (0-1) fallback when saved screen is missing.

qube.companion.position.dockEdge.description: Edge dock preference for companion placement.

qube.companion.verbal.systemPrompt.description: Optional companion-only system prompt; does not affect chat replies.

qube.companion.verbal.frequency.description: How often idle companion commentary may appear.

qube.companion.verbal.reactIngest.description: Companion may comment when library ingest completes.

qube.companion.verbal.reactDownload.description: Companion may comment when a model download completes.

qube.companion.cognition.v2.description: Use Companion Cognition v2 pipeline (observation → thought → curated expression).

qube.companion.personality.v2.description: JSON personality vector for companion cognition (warmth, humor, etc.).

qube.companion.expression.freedom.description: Sidecar expression freedom tier override for companion captions.

qube.companion.moodDrift.enabled.description: Enable slow ambient mood drift for companion cognition v3.

qube.companion.seasonal.enabled.description: Enable calendar season context for companion messages.

qube.companion.seasonal.hemisphere.description: Season hemisphere for companion seasonal context.

qube.companion.motifs.enabled.description: Enable rotating companion identity motifs in message selection.
